capability_findings.opentk: GLControl is a documented WinForms host. Stable Graphics4.9.4/GLControl4.0.2 inspected. Low-level route leaves substantially more graphics/asset infrastructure.
capability_findings.monogame: WindowsDX3.8.5.1 net8 Windows package; official2D/FuelCell3D samples identify3.8.4. Model content pipeline documented; modern official drop-in WinForms control not established.
capability_findings.stride: 4.2.1.2487 net8 and exact GameContextWinforms source; toolkit4.2 pairing preview61. Current4.3.0.2507 net10 unsuitable for unchangedSDK9. Useful3Dexamples; currentbasic2DexamplesWIP; authored models require asset workflow.
